menu:8017060:1.text: Something shady's going on for sure!
menu:8017060:1.source_cn: 一定有什么见不得人的秘密！

menu:8017070:1.text: Can you raise the price a bit?

say:0:1433501001:0.text: That penniless viscount's pretending to be rich now?
say:0:1433501001:0.source_cn: 那个落魄子爵怎么装起阔了？

say:1:1433501002:0.text: Every night, he crosses the bridge to the dwarves' side!
say:1:1433501002:0.source_cn: 他每天晚上都会过桥去矮人那边！

say:1:1433502001:1.text: I swear, that down-and-out viscount is definitely hiding something.
say:1:1433502001:1.source_cn: 我跟你说，那个落魄的子爵一定藏着什么秘密。
say:1:1433502001:1.male: I swear, that down-and-out viscount is definitely hiding something.
say:1:1433502001:1.female: I swear, that down-and-out viscount is definitely hiding something.

choice_prompt:2:1433502001.text: I swear, that down-and-out viscount is definitely hiding something.
choice_prompt:2:1433502001.source_cn: 我跟你说，那个落魄的子爵一定藏着什么秘密。
choice_prompt:2:1433502001.male: I swear, that down-and-out viscount is definitely hiding something.
choice_prompt:2:1433502001.female: I swear, that down-and-out viscount is definitely hiding something.

say:3:1433502002:0.text: He's a complete fake, riding on his ancestors' title and acting like real nobility!
say:3:1433502002:0.source_cn: 就是一个彻彻底底的穷小子，靠着祖上传下来的名头，还真拿...
say:3:1433502002:0.male: He's a complete fake, riding on his ancestors' title and acting like real nobility!
say:3:1433502002:0.female: He's a complete fake, riding on his ancestors' title and acting like real nobility!

say:4:1433502003:1.text: But lately, he's been spending like a lord. Where'd the money come from?
say:4:1433502003:1.source_cn: 可最近他花钱大手大脚的，莫不是从哪发了横财……
say:4:1433502003:1.male: But lately, he's been spending like a lord. Where'd the money come from?
say:4:1433502003:1.female: But lately, he's been spending like a lord. Where'd the money come from?

say:5:1433502006:1.text: Between you and me, he bribes the guards every night to sneak across the bridge to the dwarves' side.
say:5:1433502006:1.source_cn: 偷偷告诉你，他每天晚上都会收买守卫过桥，去王城升降井前...
say:5:1433502006:1.male: Between you and me, he bribes the guards every night to sneak across the bridge to the dwarves' side.
say:5:1433502006:1.female: Between you and me, he bribes the guards every night to sneak across the bridge to the dwarves' side.

say:6:1433502007:1.text: If only someone could spy on him at <style="highlight">night</style> by the <style="highlight">capital's lift entrance</style>...
say:6:1433502007:1.male: If only someone could spy on him at <style="highlight">night</style> by the <style="highlight">capital's lift entrance</style>...
say:6:1433502007:1.female: If only someone could spy on him at <style="highlight">night</style> by the <style="highlight">capital's lift entrance</style>...

say:8:1433502004:0.text: That guy calls himself a viscount, but he's just a poor wretch trading on his family's name.
say:8:1433502004:0.source_cn: 那人说是子爵，其实不过是靠着祖上传下的爵位招摇撞骗的穷小子。
say:8:1433502004:0.male: That guy calls himself a viscount, but he's just a poor wretch trading on his family's name.
say:8:1433502004:0.female: That guy calls himself a viscount, but he's just a poor wretch trading on his family's name.

say:9:1433502005:1.text: But lately, he's been spending like a lord. Where'd the money come from?
say:9:1433502005:1.source_cn: 可他最近花钱大手大脚的，钱从哪来？背后肯定有秘密。
say:9:1433502005:1.male: But lately, he's been spending like a lord. Where'd the money come from?
say:9:1433502005:1.female: But lately, he's been spending like a lord. Where'd the money come from?

say:1:1433504001:1.text: These heirlooms are worth a fortune! Can't you offer a bit more?
say:1:1433504001:1.source_cn: 都是祖上传下来的宝贝，你再加点价格收了嘛！

say:2:1433504002:1.text: At this rate, how will I face my ancestors?
say:2:1433504002:1.source_cn: 你开这么低的价，我怎么跟祖上交代！

say:3:1433504003:1.text: C'mon, I'm giving you a great deal. You won't find better anywhere!
say:3:1433504003:1.source_cn: 我的老顾客，这已经是良心价了！打着灯笼都找不到比我这更...

say:5:1433504004:1.text: Hey! Who's been listening to us? Who are you?!
say:5:1433504004:1.source_cn: 哎！怎么有人一直在偷听我们说话！你、你是谁！
say:5:1433504004:1.male: Hey! Who's been listening to us? Who are you?!
say:5:1433504004:1.female: Hey! Who's been listening to us? Who are you?!

choice_prompt:6:1433504004.text: Hey! Who's been listening to us? Who are you?!
choice_prompt:6:1433504004.source_cn: 哎！怎么有人一直在偷听我们说话！你、你是谁！
choice_prompt:6:1433504004.male: Hey! Who's been listening to us? Who are you?!
choice_prompt:6:1433504004.female: Hey! Who's been listening to us? Who are you?!

say:7:1433504005:1.text: W-Wait! I'm a well-known figure in the capital! Please don't tell anyone I'm selling off family treasures!
say:7:1433504005:1.source_cn: 你……在王城里我可是有头有脸的人，求你了，别把我变卖家...
say:7:1433504005:1.male: W-Wait! I'm a well-known figure in the capital! Please don't tell anyone I'm selling off family treasures!
say:7:1433504005:1.female: W-Wait! I'm a well-known figure in the capital! Please don't tell anyone I'm selling off family treasures!

say:8:1433504006:1.text: Here, take this money. That should buy your silence, right?
say:8:1433504006:1.source_cn: 这些钱给你，够封上你的嘴了吧！
say:8:1433504006:1.male: Here, take this money. That should buy your silence, right?
say:8:1433504006:1.female: Here, take this money. That should buy your silence, right?
